# Open Source AI Independence — Project overview

## Identity
Repository: https://github.com/HuffmanRepositories/Open-Source-AI-Independence
Owner: HuffmanRepositories
Status: Initial public foundation / coordination repository
License: MIT unless a file says otherwise.

## Mission
Encourage an ecosystem of independent, decentralized where appropriate, transparent, interoperable, reliable, and human-centered AI infrastructure. Connect existing open projects, identify practical gaps, and develop shared standards, integration patterns, documentation, and tools.

## Principles
Provider choice; open interfaces; transparency; evidence and uncertainty; human oversight; privacy and security; realistic decentralization; community participation; attribution; maintainability.

## Boundaries
This repository does not aim to replace all AI frameworks, OSINT platforms, security tools, or orchestration runtimes. Existing projects should be credited and integrated when possible. It currently provides mission, coordination, and planning—not production software.

## Contributing
Issues, discussions, pull requests, research, documentation, testing, design, integrations, and critique are welcome. AI-generated contributions must be reviewed and verified by submitters.
